ttea.util.helpkeyfilter

Application-wide F1 key handling for the help system.

The F1 shortcut of the main window does not fire while a modal dialog is open, because Qt blocks window shortcuts of windows shadowed by a modal dialog. This filter is installed on the QApplication and sees F1 in every window, including modal dialogs.

Classes

HelpKeyFilter

Call a function whenever F1 is pressed in any window.
